candidate_decisions.title: Humanity’s First Exam
candidate_decisions.reason: A public reliability benchmark tests consistency across prompt variants; date precision is preserved.

candidate_decisions.title: Delegent
candidate_decisions.reason: Public Apache-2.0 code makes the author-reported cost-saving delegation pattern testable.

candidate_decisions.title: GPT-6 protein design
candidate_decisions.reason: A major official research publication with wet-lab evidence was missed just before the overlap start; limitations and late discovery are explicit.

candidate_decisions.title: WePocketModel MLX
candidate_decisions.reason: New Apple-silicon MLX weights and runtime materially lower local multimodal deployment barriers.

candidate_decisions.title: Claude Code 2.1.332
candidate_decisions.reason: MCP skills, a pre-load refusal hook and broad long-session recovery fixes materially change the tracked tool.

candidate_decisions.title: LiteLLM 1.108.17 LTS
candidate_decisions.reason: The signed LTS backport fixes tool, billing, schema and provider failures.

candidate_decisions.title: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview weights
candidate_decisions.reason: The prior manifest deferred the lead only because the official card was unreadable; downloadable weights and deployment recipes are now verified.

candidate_decisions.title: Ling-3.2-air independent evaluation
candidate_decisions.reason: Artificial Analysis supplies an independent score and reveals extreme output volume while speed and price remain missing.

candidate_decisions.title: Qwen Code 1.0.0-preview.2
candidate_decisions.reason: The preview adds subscription catalog and quota UX but does not replace tracked stable 0.28.4.

candidate_decisions.title: Codex 0.174 alpha builds
candidate_decisions.reason: Only alpha builds shipped; the stable-only rule prevents promotion.

candidate_decisions.title: IBM CUGA Indic voice-agent tutorial
candidate_decisions.reason: A useful runnable multilingual RAG pattern, but a tutorial application rather than a new platform or capability release.

candidate_decisions.title: Microduck obstacle-avoidance workflow
candidate_decisions.reason: Reproducible sim-to-real instructions add no new platform or model release.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI Astra exoplanet case study
candidate_decisions.reason: Promising candidates remain unconfirmed and the article is a vendor case study, not a validated discovery.

candidate_decisions.title: Cosmos 3 Nano 12GB offload tutorial
candidate_decisions.reason: The path lowers VRAM but adds large system-memory and latency costs; the existing TRIAL judgment remains unchanged.

candidate_decisions.title: OmniAct
candidate_decisions.reason: The project link was unavailable and no verified code or weights were found.

candidate_decisions.title: AIChipBench
candidate_decisions.reason: Strong benchmark methodology is reported, but no verified public code or dataset was found.

candidate_decisions.title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding
candidate_decisions.reason: The paper reports author gains without a public implementation or workload-complete throughput evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: EmbodiSafety
candidate_decisions.reason: A dataset surface exists, but reported failure rates lack independent validation and no immediate engineering action was established.

candidate_decisions.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro ten-minute degradation
candidate_decisions.reason: A resolved ten-minute degradation lacks broad customer impact.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI healthcare model configurations
candidate_decisions.reason: The November 24 changelog has no time, so strict placement after the prior checkpoint is unresolved.

candidate_decisions.title: AWS Bedrock watermark model coverage
candidate_decisions.reason: The November 25 documentation change has date-only precision and clarifies coverage rather than a new mechanism.

candidate_decisions.title: Gemini 4 Neon builder stories
candidate_decisions.reason: Examples add no independent capability or availability change.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI customer stories
candidate_decisions.reason: Vendor customer stories do not add enough independently verifiable engineering evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: Remaining current arXiv AI digest
candidate_decisions.reason: The remaining papers lacked the combined artifact, evidence and engineering value needed for this run.

candidate_decisions.title: Five due seven-day reviews
candidate_decisions.reason: FrontierHarness, harness adapters, FastFrames, KORMo-Web and PostHog decision models were checked; no recommendation-changing evidence was verified.

candidate_decisions.title: Anthropic breaks below $83 IPO price
candidate_decisions.reason: Ordinary post-IPO price movement does not change AI capability, access, engineering or ecosystem judgment.

candidate_decisions.title: Ask HN: Anthropic is accusing my company of distilling. How can I prove I'm not?
candidate_decisions.reason: An unverified Ask HN allegation provides no primary evidence or adjudicated finding.

candidate_decisions.title: Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed
candidate_decisions.reason: Public code makes a material inference-isolation failure mode reproducible.

candidate_decisions.title: PenGPT: A Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
candidate_decisions.reason: High community heat merits an explicit IGNORE judgment because data is withheld and examples are selected.

candidate_decisions.title: Show HN: Old Nvidia and ATI tech demos, running again in the browser
candidate_decisions.reason: A browser preservation gallery for old GPU demos is not a new AI or strategic technology change.

candidate_decisions.title: A training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
candidate_decisions.reason: The public local-training engine is directly testable and relevant to coding-agent practice.

candidate_decisions.title: Anthropic Staff Openly Talk About ‘Taking Over the World’, Claims Max Tegmark
candidate_decisions.reason: Second-hand commentary about staff attitudes lacks a product, policy or verified operational change.

candidate_decisions.title: Gemini refused to give me the lyrics to Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
candidate_decisions.reason: A single user anecdote about a refusal is not a reproducible product or policy change.

candidate_decisions.title: Marginalia Search, Money, C++, Rust, AI, Stuff
candidate_decisions.reason: A personal project update essay contains no discrete verified AI capability or availability change.

candidate_decisions.title: Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1
candidate_decisions.reason: Apache-2.0 bilingual reasoning and tool-use weights with deployable serving paths were missed.

candidate_decisions.title: thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research
candidate_decisions.reason: Open weights expose an actionable inference-compute control on one checkpoint.

candidate_decisions.title: inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL
candidate_decisions.reason: A distinct open multimodal medical model requires its own risk-bounded judgment.

candidate_decisions.title: MemTensor/MemT-1.0-Pro
candidate_decisions.reason: Public weights expose a materially different persistent-memory architecture, while scale and evidence keep it at WATCH.

gap_review.scope: No weekly targeted gap review was due; directed late-discovery checks closed the deferred ERNIE lead and recovered one important pre-overlap OpenAI publication.
